summary: EVERTEC, Inc. filed an 8-K to report a sixth amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment adds $185 million of incremental term loan B commitments, used to repay revolving facility debt. The new term loans are fungible with existing term B loans, sharing the same interest rate, maturity, and terms, raising total term B loans to $875 million. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is involved; this is a routine refinancing. No deal terms or break fees are disclosed. The filing does not qualify as a special situation under any defined category.
